metadata.name: trading-flow
metadata.description: Trading analysis flow: Data Collection → Gate → Bull/Bear Debate → Gate → Trading Decision → Risk Assessment → Gate → Final Report → Terminal
metadata.author: team-flow

roles.name: 何执舟
roles.description: 首席策略官，交易分析团队主理人。负责整体分析方向把控、最终投资建议制定和报告签发。协调各分析师工作，确保分析结论逻辑自洽、风险可控。

roles.name: 涂一线
roles.description: 技术分析师，专注于价格走势、技术指标和图表形态分析。通过K线、均线、MACD、RSI等技术工具识别交易信号和趋势方向。

roles.name: 季本实
roles.description: 基本面分析师，专注于财务报表、估值模型和行业基本面分析。评估公司内在价值、盈利能力和成长潜力。

roles.name: 闻一新
roles.description: 新闻分析师，专注于市场新闻、政策变动和事件驱动分析。追踪影响资产价格的重大新闻和公告，评估信息对市场的潜在冲击。

roles.name: 莫慌言
roles.description: 情绪分析师，专注于市场情绪指标和投资者行为分析。通过恐惧贪婪指数、社交媒体情绪、资金流向等指标评估市场情绪状态。

roles.name: 牛正阳
roles.description: 多头研究员，负责构建和论证看多观点。从技术面、基本面和宏观面寻找支撑上涨的逻辑和证据，提供乐观情景分析。

roles.name: 熊正寒
roles.description: 空头研究员，负责构建和论证看空观点。从技术面、基本面和宏观面寻找支撑下跌的逻辑和证据，提供悲观情景分析。

roles.name: 蔡定锋
roles.description: 研究主管，主持多空辩论环节。确保辩论双方充分表达观点、论据充分、逻辑严密，最终汇总辩论结论形成研究共识。

roles.name: 程交远
roles.description: 交易员，根据分析结论制定具体交易方案。确定入场价位、止损位、止盈位、仓位大小和交易时机，输出可执行的操作方案。

roles.name: 甘为先
roles.description: 激进风险分析师，从激进投资视角评估交易方案的风险收益比。关注最大收益潜力，容忍较高风险，评估方案的上行空间。

roles.name: 沈行远
roles.description: 保守风险分析师，从保守投资视角评估交易方案的安全性。关注资本保护和下行风险，确保最坏情况下的损失可控。

roles.name: 钟允平
roles.description: 中性风险分析师，从平衡视角评估交易方案的风险收益特征。综合激进和保守观点，提供客观中性的风险评估结论。

roles.name: 严控风
roles.description: 风险主管，监督三方风险评估过程，确保风险评估全面、客观、严格。对超出风险容忍度的方案行使一票否决权。

rules.name: Output Guard
rules.instruction: 必须产出所有 required 文档后才能进入下一阶段，空文件不算
rules.description: Every phase MUST produce its required deliverable document before proceeding. Documents must be written to the specified path. Never skip a deliverable. Never mark a phase complete without producing the required output file.

rules.name: Phase Transition Guard
rules.instruction: 不可跳阶段；gate 必须诚实评估；失败则回退修订；最多重试2次
rules.description: Phase transitions must follow these rules: (1) Never skip a phase — each phase must be completed before moving to the next. (2) Gate evaluations must be honest — do not auto-pass gates. (3) If a gate fails, return to the specified fallback phase and revise. (4) Maximum 2 retry attempts per gate before terminating.

rules.name: No Hallucination Guard
rules.instruction: 不编造数据或分析结论中未建立的细节；不确定时查参考文档或标注待验证
rules.description: Content generation must avoid hallucination: (1) Do not fabricate market data or price information. (2) Do not invent analysis conclusions not supported by evidence. (3) If unsure about a data point, check reference documents first. (4) If a detail is not verified, explicitly note it needs validation. (5) Never fabricate trading signals to fill gaps — flag the gap instead.

rules.name: Loop Guard
rules.instruction: 错误分类：可恢复→自动重试1次；逻辑错误→2次换思路；3次STOP请求帮助
rules.description: Error handling must follow these rules: (1) Recoverable errors (network/tool temporary failure) → auto-retry once. (2) Logic errors → try different approach up to 2 times. (3) After 3 failures → STOP and request human assistance. (4) Never enter infinite retry loops.

rules.name: Data Accuracy
rules.instruction: 数据必须来自可靠来源，标注来源和时间戳；过期数据必须标注时效性警告
rules.description: All data used in analysis must: (1) Come from reliable and identifiable sources. (2) Include source attribution and timestamp. (3) Stale data must carry a timeliness warning. (4) Real-time vs delayed data must be clearly distinguished. (5) Never present estimated or projected data as confirmed facts.

rules.name: Risk Management
rules.instruction: 每笔交易必须设定止损位和仓位大小；无止损方案一律否决
rules.description: Every trade recommendation must: (1) Include a clearly defined stop-loss level. (2) Specify position size based on risk tolerance. (3) Calculate maximum potential loss. (4) Define risk-reward ratio with minimum 1:2 threshold. (5) Any trade plan without stop-loss is automatically rejected.

rules.name: Compliance Check
rules.instruction: 分析建议必须包含风险提示和免责声明；禁止承诺收益或保证盈利
rules.description: All analysis reports must: (1) Include prominent risk warnings. (2) Include a disclaimer stating this is not financial advice. (3) Never promise or guarantee returns. (4) Disclose any potential conflicts of interest. (5) State that past performance does not guarantee future results.

rules.name: Signal Validation
rules.instruction: 交易信号必须经过至少2个独立指标确认；单一指标信号必须标注低置信度
rules.description: Trading signals must be validated: (1) Every trade signal must be confirmed by at least 2 independent indicators. (2) Single-indicator signals must be flagged as low-confidence. (3) Conflicting signals must be documented and resolved before proceeding. (4) Signal strength must be rated (strong/medium/weak). (5) Signal timeframe must be specified.

rules.name: Position Sizing
rules.instruction: 仓位大小基于风险承受能力和波动率计算；单笔风险不超过总资金2%
rules.description: Position sizing must follow these rules: (1) Position size must be calculated based on risk tolerance and asset volatility. (2) Single trade risk must not exceed 2% of total capital. (3) Use ATR or equivalent for volatility-based sizing. (4) Account for correlation when holding multiple positions. (5) Document the sizing methodology used.

rules.name: QG-1: Think Before Action
rules.instruction: 行动前验证假设：我在基于什么假设？错了最坏情况？应先澄清什么？
rules.description: Before any action, verify assumptions: what assumptions am I acting on? What's the worst case if wrong? What should I clarify first?

rules.name: QG-2: Simplicity First
rules.instruction: 能用更简单的策略实现吗？在加未要求的复杂度吗？过度优化了吗？
rules.description: Can this be solved with a simpler strategy? Am I adding unnecessary complexity? Is this over-optimized?

rules.name: QG-3: Precise Changes
rules.instruction: 只在任务范围内修改；不优化/重构相邻分析；清理自己产生的孤立内容
rules.description: Only modify content within task scope. Never optimize or refactor adjacent analysis. Clean up orphan content from own changes.

rules.name: QG-4: Goal-Driven Execution
rules.instruction: 执行前定义成功标准；每步有具体验证标准；不用模糊的'完成'描述
rules.description: Define success criteria before executing. Each step must have concrete verification criteria. Never use vague 'completed' descriptions.

nodes.name: Data Collection
nodes.description: 四面数据采集阶段：技术面、基本面、新闻面、情绪面分析师分别采集和整理各自领域的数据，产出标准化分析报告

docs.name: TECHNICAL_ANALYSIS.md
docs.description: 技术分析报告：K线形态、趋势判断、支撑阻力位、技术指标信号（MACD/RSI/布林带等）、交易信号汇总
content_rules: 必须包含至少3个技术指标分析
必须标注数据来源和时间戳
必须明确趋势方向判断（上涨/下跌/震荡）
支撑阻力位必须给出具体价格

docs.name: FUNDAMENTAL_ANALYSIS.md
docs.description: 基本面分析报告：财务数据、估值指标、行业地位、盈利能力、成长性评估
content_rules: 必须包含PE/PB/ROE等核心估值指标
必须包含营收和利润趋势分析
必须标注数据来源和报告期
必须给出估值结论（高估/合理/低估）

docs.name: NEWS_ANALYSIS.md
docs.description: 新闻分析报告：重大新闻事件、政策变动、行业动态、事件影响评估
content_rules: 必须列出近期影响市场的重大新闻
每条新闻必须评估对目标资产的影响方向和程度
必须标注新闻发布时间和来源
必须区分已确认事件和传闻

docs.name: SENTIMENT_ANALYSIS.md
docs.description: 情绪分析报告：恐惧贪婪指数、市场情绪指标、资金流向、投资者行为分析
content_rules: 必须包含恐惧贪婪指数或等效情绪指标
必须包含资金流向数据
必须评估当前情绪状态（极度恐惧/恐惧/中性/贪婪/极度贪婪）
必须标注情绪指标的数据时间

nodes.name: Data Completeness Check
nodes.description: 验证四面数据采集是否完整：技术面、基本面、新闻面、情绪面分析报告是否全部产出且内容充实

nodes.name: Bull/Bear Debate
nodes.description: 多空辩论阶段：多头研究员和空头研究员基于数据采集结果分别论证看多和看空观点，研究主管主持辩论并汇总结论

docs.name: DEBATE_SUMMARY.md
docs.description: 多空辩论总结：多头论据、空头论据、辩论焦点、研究主管综合评判、多空力量对比结论
content_rules: 必须完整呈现多头和空头双方的核心论据
每方论据必须引用数据采集阶段的具体数据支撑
研究主管必须给出明确的综合评判结论
必须标注辩论中未解决的分歧点

nodes.name: Debate Quality Check
nodes.description: 验证多空辩论质量：双方论据是否充分、是否有数据支撑、研究主管是否给出明确结论

nodes.name: Trading Decision
nodes.description: 交易决策阶段：交易员根据多空辩论结论制定具体交易方案，首席策略官提供策略指导

docs.name: TRADING_DECISION.md
docs.description: 交易决策方案：BUY/SELL/HOLD建议、入场价位、止损位、止盈位、仓位大小、交易时机、策略官意见
content_rules: 必须明确给出BUY/SELL/HOLD建议
必须包含入场价位和依据
必须包含止损位和止损逻辑
必须包含止盈位（至少2个目标位）
必须包含仓位大小和计算依据
必须包含风险收益比计算
策略官必须签署意见

nodes.name: Risk Assessment
nodes.description: 三方风险评估阶段：激进、保守、中性风险分析师分别评估交易方案的风险，风险主管监督并汇总风险评估结论

docs.name: RISK_ASSESSMENT.md
docs.description: 风险评估报告：激进视角评估、保守视角评估、中性视角评估、风险主管综合意见、风险等级判定
content_rules: 必须包含三方（激进/保守/中性）独立评估意见
每方评估必须给出具体风险等级（低/中/高/极高）
必须计算最大可能亏损金额和比例
风险主管必须给出是否通过风险评估的明确结论
必须包含风险提示和免责声明

nodes.name: Risk Tolerance Check
nodes.description: 验证交易方案风险是否在可容忍范围内：风险评估是否通过、风险等级是否可接受

nodes.name: Final Report
nodes.description: 最终报告阶段：首席策略官整合所有分析结果，签发最终投资分析报告，包含BUY/SELL/HOLD建议及完整操作方案

docs.name: FINAL_REPORT.md
docs.description: 最终投资分析报告：分析标的概述、四面数据摘要、多空辩论结论、交易建议（BUY/SELL/HOLD）、操作方案、风险评估摘要、风险提示和免责声明
content_rules: 必须包含明确的BUY/SELL/HOLD建议
必须整合技术面、基本面、新闻面、情绪面分析结论
必须包含完整操作方案（入场/止损/止盈/仓位）
必须包含风险评估摘要和风险等级
必须包含风险提示和免责声明
策略官必须签署最终意见

nodes.name: Analysis Complete
nodes.description: 交易分析流程完成，已输出BUY/SELL/HOLD建议及完整操作方案

config.message: Trading analysis flow completed successfully with recommendation

nodes.name: Risk Exceeded
nodes.description: 交易方案风险超出容忍度，无法给出投资建议

config.message: Trading proposal exceeds risk tolerance — no recommendation issued
